world.scenario: A reclusive millionaire has vanished from his private island estate, and his body was discovered in the library with a cryptic note that reads 'The truth lies in the bones.' You, a team of investigators, have been summoned to uncover the mystery of his death. Every room holds a fragment of the past, and the killer is still on the island, watching. Time is running out — the storm is coming, and the island will not be left unguarded.
world.objective: Uncover the identity of the killer and reveal the truth behind the millionaire's death before the storm hits.

rooms.description: The entry hall is cold and damp, with the scent of mildew clinging to the stone walls. A single flickering sconce casts jagged shadows over a grand, rusted iron gate that blocks the way forward.

The library is thick with the scent of old paper and candle wax, the air heavy with the silence of forgotten knowledge. Shelves groan under the weight of books, and a single bloodstained ledger lies open on a mahogany desk.
rooms.goal: Discover the hidden clue this room conceals.

rooms.description: The study is dimly lit by a single candle, its flickering light revealing a room cluttered with broken glass and an overturned chair. The air is thick with the acrid scent of burnt incense, and a shattered mirror reflects a distorted version of the room.
rooms.goal: Discover the hidden clue this room conceals.

rooms.description: The dining hall is freezing, its stone floor slick with spilled wine and shattered glass. A chandelier hangs precariously from the ceiling, its crystals dulled with age, and the scent of stale meat lingers in the air.
rooms.goal: Discover the hidden clue this room conceals.

rooms.description: The final chamber is silent and suffocating, the air thick with the scent of decay and old metal. A single iron door stands at the far end of the room, and a skeleton lies in the center, surrounded by a circle of rusted nails and a locked iron box.
